senses.gloss: f. (cmp. גֵּב) little reservoir, whence tube, channel. Targ. II Esth. I, 3 ג׳ דכוחלא the tube containing the eye-paint; Ber. 18ᵇ גּוּבְתָאִי דכ׳ my tube &c.—
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 90b:4">Sabb. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>רמי ליה בג׳ דנחשא</he> one puts it into a bronze tube.
<cite ref="Shabbat 146b:4">Ib. 146ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳</he> to insert a tube into the barrel.
<cite ref="Chullin 58b:7">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ההיא ג׳ וכ׳</he> a channel was discovered forming the passage from the second stomach &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 75b:16">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דשכבת זרע</he> the channel for the effusion of semen.
